title: SB6347 (2019-2020 Regular): Extending the expiration date for a concealed pistol license.

provenance.fetched_by: Open States public data converted to LegiScan layout (gun-policy Stage 5, Washington); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Washington Legislature text (Introduced, https://lawfilesext.leg.wa.gov/Biennium/2019-20/Htm/Bills/Senate%20Bills/6347.htm, downloaded directly)
provenance.note: Introduced version. Training must cover: basic firearms safety rules; firearms and children (secure storage); suicide prevention; secure storage; safe handling; state and federal firearms laws. Fee subsection (5) extended to the seven-year license; other edits are wording.

operative_text:
Sec. 1 (RCW 9.41.070): (16)(a) A license issued under this section is valid for seven years if the applicant provides proof that the applicant has completed a recognized firearm safety training program within the last five years that, at a minimum, includes instruction on:
Sec. 1 (RCW 9.41.070): (b) The training must be sponsored by a federal, state, county, or municipal law enforcement agency, a college or university, a nationally recognized organization that customarily offers firearms training, or a firearms training school with instructors certified by a nationally recognized organization that customarily offers firearms training. The proof of training shall be in the form of a certification that states under the penalty of perjury the training included the minimum requirements.
